data.name: First Impact: Rise of a Hero
data.detailed_description:
Play It How You Want!


Acerca do jogo

First Impact: Rise of a Hero transforms you into a superhero and forces you to uncover the truth behind mysterious meteors that are falling towards earth. You were once a normal citizen and now you have command over the elements and can take to the skies. In this open-world, action-RPG, you will meet supportive characters who also want to discover what is really happening. Square off against a cast of villains and complete various missions as you unravel this game's plot. Do you dare to be super?

Play in VR or on your PC


Features


CONTROL THE FOUR ELEMENTS - Skewer enemies with spikes of earth, fry them to a crisp with a heated fireball, impale them with ice shards or just send them flying with tornados.

CHOOSE HOW YOU MOVE - Have you ever wanted to truly experience flying? Then with the push of a button take to the skies and fly between buildings, among clouds and avoid birds and airplanes. Got a fear of heights? Not a problem, as a superhero you can move at super speed and get anywhere you want to go. Just don't forget that you can also teleport if need be and scale large buildings through your super jump!

INTERACT WITH YOUR ENVIRONMENT - With your super strength you can lift a variety of objects within the game. Did your neighbor irritate you? Park their car somewhere else for them... that same car can be used for pitching practice or even a hammer to take on that pesky thug who keeps trying to attack you.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH - You weren't always super, so it's up to you to find out why the world seems to be going through this chaos. Meet your three support characters, General Barclay Whitehill, Dr. Ernest Giorgio and Chieftain Aulani. These three will work with you in uncovering the truth behind the meteor showers and guide you as you take on your newfound challenges as a hero. Prepare for a fun and engaging story.

IMMERSE YOURSELF - With the combination of the comic book art style and original audio, prepare to get lost in the world of First Impact: Rise of a Hero. This game aims to remind you of the good old days of reading the latest issue of your favourite comic and imagining yourself as the hero. The only difference is that you actually are the hero!

data.short_description: First Impact: Rise of a Hero immerses you in a beautiful comic book world where you can run, jump, fly, and summon elemental powers to protect citizens. Experience a lush array of islands and cityscapes and uncover the truth about a mysterious force sending meteors to Earth. For PC & VR!

reviews.review:
First Impact: Rise of a Hero is an ambitious independent superhero adventure that centers on fulfilling one of gaming's most enduring fantasies: becoming an unstoppable protector with incredible powers. Rather than grounding its world in realism, the game embraces the colorful spirit of comic books, placing players in the role of an ordinary person whose life changes forever after mysterious meteors begin striking Earth. These unexplained events awaken extraordinary abilities and set the stage for a journey that gradually uncovers the larger mystery behind the catastrophe. While the storyline follows familiar superhero themes, it remains engaging thanks to a cast of allies and mentors who help shape the protagonist's growth while introducing new objectives and revelations throughout the campaign.

The game's greatest appeal lies in the freedom it gives players to experience life as a genuine superhero. Traversal is exceptionally entertaining, allowing players to soar through the skies, teleport across large distances, sprint at remarkable speeds, or launch themselves high into the air with superhuman leaps. Every method of movement feels designed to emphasize speed and power rather than restriction, making simple exploration enjoyable even when there are no immediate objectives. The open environments encourage players to move however they choose, whether gliding over city skylines or exploring islands scattered throughout the world. This constant sense of mobility helps distinguish the game from many other open-world action titles, making exploration feel like an integral part of the adventure instead of merely traveling between missions.

Combat builds upon this feeling of empowerment by giving players command over the four classical elements. Earth, fire, ice, and wind each provide unique offensive capabilities, allowing encounters to remain visually dynamic while offering multiple approaches to defeating enemies. Massive stone spikes erupt from the ground, blazing projectiles explode on impact, icy attacks strike with precision, and powerful tornadoes scatter opponents across the battlefield. These elemental abilities are complemented by the hero's overwhelming physical strength, which allows vehicles and environmental objects to become improvised weapons. Tossing cars at enemies or interacting with the world in exaggerated ways reinforces the comic-book atmosphere and creates moments that feel both satisfying and entertaining without taking themselves too seriously.

Beyond its action mechanics, the game attempts to deliver a balanced mix of storytelling, exploration, and progression. Missions gradually reveal more about the mysterious meteor showers and the origin of the protagonist's newfound abilities while introducing characters who provide guidance and context. The narrative unfolds at a steady pace, encouraging players to continue exploring in order to uncover additional pieces of the larger conflict. Although the story does not reinvent the superhero genre, it succeeds in creating an enjoyable backdrop that supports the gameplay without overwhelming it. The comic-inspired visual presentation complements this approach, favoring vibrant environments and stylized character designs that capture the adventurous tone the developers clearly intended.

One of the game's most notable achievements is the variety packed into its overall design. It combines open-world exploration, action RPG elements, superhero powers, environmental interaction, and optional virtual reality compatibility into a single experience. While some mechanics naturally lack the refinement associated with blockbuster productions, the scope of the project is impressive considering its independent origins. The seamless transition between high-speed movement, aerial exploration, and elemental combat keeps the gameplay fresh over time, ensuring that players are regularly experimenting with different abilities rather than relying on a single tactic.

First Impact: Rise of a Hero ultimately succeeds because it understands the appeal of superhero fiction. It focuses on making players feel incredibly powerful while offering enough freedom to enjoy those abilities in creative ways. Flying across expansive environments, unleashing devastating elemental attacks, lifting massive objects with ease, and uncovering the mystery surrounding Earth's strange meteor phenomenon all contribute to an experience that captures the excitement of becoming a larger-than-life hero. Although some aspects reveal the limitations of its independent development, the game's ambition, enjoyable traversal, and satisfying power fantasy make it an entertaining adventure for players looking for an accessible open-world superhero experience.

Rating: 5/10
